decisive_items: a non-homogeneous, mass-like prominence at the base of the tongue compressing the epiglottis and narrowing the pharynx
several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue, and no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location
response.rationale: The presence of a mass-like prominence at the base of the tongue with calcifications and the absence of a normal thyroid gland in the neck are more consistent with a thyroglossal duct cyst than ectopic thyroid tissue

rejected.why: less specific imaging findings and lack of characteristic calcifications
